label: <DEL> delimiter step (plus input q)
explanation: Fires mainly at the <DEL> delimiter step (28% of delimiter steps; ~50% of activation mass; the top activations are at <DEL> or the first copy step that follows), and on input token q in any phase (25% rate, ~17% mass). Weaker activity on the first copy step (recall_idx 1) and on inputs 1/x. It is silent at t=0 and rare elsewhere in the original and later copy phases. Whether it fires at <DEL> depends on which tokens are in the sequence: it is more likely when h/k/r/d/e/b appeared earlier (precision rises to ~0.53) and when the first token to be copied is w/k/t. This content dependence is diffuse, so precision stays low (~0.27) and about a third of the mass falls outside the predicate.
